calls.title: Joule Work for Desktop: pilot kickoff
summary: Pilot with 300 users on Windows and macOS starts on 1 January 2027; 120 volunteers have already signed up, mostly from procurement and finance.
Security wants to know where prompts and files are processed and has a 62-question questionnaire that is due before the works council meeting on 5 November.
The works council will ask about monitoring; usage data is aggregated by default and the options need to be documented.

decisions.text: Go ahead with the pilot plan and the security review in parallel

actions.text: Send architecture sheet (where prompts and files are processed)
Short briefing paper for the works council

risks.text: Works council approval gates the pilot start; they will ask about individual monitoring

turns.text: Welcome, everyone. The pilot is 300 users on Windows and macOS for one year, starting on 1 January. Today we align on the plan and the open security topics.
IT is excited. We already have 120 volunteers, mostly from procurement and finance.
From the security side I need to know where prompts and files are processed, and whether local files ever leave the device.
Files stay local unless the user attaches them to a request. Prompts are processed in the EU region. I will send you the architecture sheet.
Then please complete our security questionnaire. It has 62 questions and I need it before the works council meeting on 5 November.
Speaking of the works council: they will ask about monitoring. Can you confirm that usage data is not tied to individuals?
Usage is aggregated by default. I will document the available options so you can show them to the works council.
Next steps: the security questionnaire and a short paper for the works council, both by 30 October.

calls.title: Ariba renewal: check-in before the notice date
summary: The customer is broadly satisfied with Ariba, but a price benchmark puts comparable suites about 8 % below the offer (OFF-2026-0318, 305,000 EUR per year).
A 3-year term is possible if about 40 additional buyers from the Polish subsidiary can be added without renegotiation.
The procurement board meets on 28 October, so the revised quote is needed by 23 October. The notice date of the current contract is 2 November.

decisions.text: Prepare a revised quote with a 3-year option and a price for 40 extra buyers

actions.text: Revised Ariba quote (3-year option, +40 buyers, per-seat price)
Get deal desk approval for a multi-year discount
Status update on TKT-48213 (Joule, open purchase orders) to the customer

risks.text: Churn risk: the customer would look at alternatives if the board sees no price movement
The open Joule ticket TKT-48213 weakens the renewal case

turns.text: Thanks for making time. The goal today: where do we stand on the Ariba renewal before the notice date on 2 November?
We are broadly happy. Adoption among the 250 buyers is good. But Jonas has a benchmark that shows lower prices elsewhere.
Our benchmark puts comparable procurement suites about 8 percent below your offer of 305,000 euros. I need a justification, or a better number.
Understood. The offer is for two years. If you commit to three years I can look at a multi-year discount, but I have to check with the deal desk.
Three years is possible if the contract lets us add buyers without a new negotiation. We plan to onboard about 40 more buyers from the Poland subsidiary next year.
And I need the revised quote in writing by 23 October, otherwise we cannot take it to the procurement board on 28 October.
Noted, 23 October. I will include a price for the extra 40 buyers as an option.
One more thing: the Joule ticket on purchase order results is still open. It would help if that is fixed before the board meets.
I will ask support for the status of TKT-48213 and send you an update together with the quote.
If the numbers work we have no reason to switch. But we would have to look at alternatives if the board sees no movement.
To recap: revised quote by 23 October with a 3-year option and a price for 40 extra buyers, plus an update on the ticket.

calls.title: Quarterly business review
summary: Adoption is stable; the customer wants the Q3 adoption report in a format the management team can read without a walkthrough.
A migration workshop with a partner is of interest, but no new commitments will be made after 30 November because the budget cycle closes.

decisions.text: Plan a migration workshop for early December, without a purchase commitment

actions.text: Send Q3 adoption report as a one-page summary
Introduce a partner for the migration workshop

risks.text: Budget cycle closes on 30 November; anything not agreed by then slips into next year

turns.text: Thanks, Petra. Let us start with the numbers for Q3 and then talk about what is next.
Usage looks stable. For my management team I need it on one page, they will not read a long deck.
I will send a one-page summary this week.
We are thinking about moving the remaining on-premise reports. A workshop with a partner could help.
I can introduce a partner. Early December would work for a first session.
Please keep in mind our budget closes at the end of November, so no new commitments after that.

calls.title: SuccessFactors: scope and term for 2027
summary: After the restructuring the customer expects about 4,500 employees instead of 4,800, so the renewal should be right-sized with a flex clause of plus or minus 10 %.
The 7 % price increase in OFF-2026-0311 was criticised; at 4,500 employees the increase shrinks and a corrected offer is needed.
Employee data must stay in the EU; written confirmation and data centre documentation were requested.

decisions.text: Quote 4,500 employees for 3 years with a ±10 % flex clause
Defer the Time Tracking module until after Q2 (budget freeze)

actions.text: Corrected offer OFF-2026-0311 for 4,500 employees with flex clause

risks.text: The announced 7 % price increase is a sticking point for Finance

turns.text: Today we want to settle scope and term for Employee Central for 2027.
The biggest change: after the restructuring we expect about 4,500 employees, not 4,800. We do not want to pay for seats we will not use.
Technically no problem to right-size. The new Time Tracking module could also replace your separate timesheet tool.
Interesting, but not this year. The budget is frozen until Q2.
Then let us quote 4,500 employees for three years, with a flex clause of plus or minus 10 percent.
The flex clause is exactly what Finance wants. But the current offer shows a 7 percent price increase. How do you justify that?
Part of it comes from the 4,800 base. At 4,500 the increase drops. I will send a corrected offer.
Good. Also data residency: all employee data must stay in the EU. Please confirm that in writing.
Confirmed in principle. I will send the data centre documentation.
Fine. If the corrected offer arrives next week, we can sign before year end.

calls.title: Escalation: AI Core quota exceeded in eu10
summary: The document pipeline was down for about six hours after the AI Core deployment quota in eu10 was exceeded by the invoice scanning batch.
The customer was not warned before the limit and wants a usage alert plus a written root cause analysis for their CIO.
A repeat would put the Joule Work for Desktop pilot (OFF-2026-0324) at risk.

decisions.text: Temporarily double the eu10 quota within two working days
Set usage alerts at 80 % of quota

actions.text: Request temporary quota increase in eu10
Written root cause analysis to the customer CIO
Configure usage alert at 80 % of quota

risks.text: A repeat incident puts the Joule Work pilot and the AI units contract at risk

turns.text: Our document pipeline stopped yesterday. AI Core hit the quota in eu10 and nothing was processed for six hours.
I can see ticket TKT-48107. A deployment quota was exceeded after a spike from the invoice scanning batch.
Nobody warned us. We pay 360,000 euros a year for AI units and have no alert before we hit the limit.
That is a fair point. Let us look at a temporary quota increase and a usage alert.
I can request a temporary increase to double the capacity within two working days. The root cause analysis follows by 21 October.
Fine, but I need a written RCA for our CIO. If this repeats, the Joule Work pilot is at risk.
Understood. I will make sure the CIO gets the RCA directly, and we set the alerts at 80 percent.
OK. Please keep me informed daily until the quota is raised.
